g.text: Success = successes / valid outcomes; valid subsets differ. Valid counts (Sol / Luna / N3 / N5): BrowserCode 266 / 269 / 269 / 267; native 286 / 271 / 270 / 270.
X-axis means include measured invalid attempts. Latency coverage: BrowserCode 275 / 274 / 275 / 273; native 300 / 300 / 300 / 298.
Command coverage: BrowserCode 300 / 300 / 293 / 294; native 300 / 300 / 300 / 298. Executions can contain multiple actions; granularity differs.
Cost coverage: 300 each. BrowserCode original receipts (N3: one unknown-usage call); native includes helpers and full reserves. External judging excluded.
Within-harness x-axis ranges differ. Collection windows, timing scopes and limits differ (BrowserCode 12,288 tokens / 30 decisions; native 20,000 / 100); descriptive comparison.
